name: flip-button
title: Flip Button
description: Button that flips like a card on hover and keyboard focus to reveal a second line on the back.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style, the same set as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 40, or 48px, the same as Button.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Text on the back face. Vue and Blade also take a back slot. Falls back to the label.

a11y: A native button element, so Enter and Space work and focus shows a 2px primary outline.
The back face is aria-hidden, so the accessible name is always the front label.
Keyboard focus flips the button too, so keyboard users see the same back text.
With prefers-reduced-motion the faces swap without the 3D turn.

ai.whenToUse: A call to action whose back adds a reassuring detail, such as file size, price, or time needed.
rules: Put the action on the front, the back only adds detail
Do not hide required information on the back, touch users may never see it
Keep both faces about the same length

id.description: Tombol yang berputar seperti kartu saat hover dan fokus keyboard untuk menampilkan teks kedua di sisi belakang.

props.backLabel: Teks di sisi belakang. Vue dan Blade juga menerima slot back. Jika kosong memakai label utama.

a11y: Elemen button native, jadi Enter dan Spasi berfungsi dan fokus tampil sebagai outline 2px warna primary.
Sisi belakang aria-hidden, jadi nama aksesibel selalu label depan.
Fokus keyboard juga memutar tombol, jadi pengguna keyboard melihat teks belakang yang sama.
Dengan prefers-reduced-motion sisi berganti tanpa putaran 3D.

ai.whenToUse: Ajakan bertindak yang sisi belakangnya menambah detail meyakinkan, seperti ukuran file, harga, atau waktu yang dibutuhkan.
rules: Taruh aksi di depan, sisi belakang hanya menambah detail
Jangan sembunyikan informasi penting di belakang, pengguna sentuh mungkin tidak pernah melihatnya
Buat kedua sisi kurang lebih sama panjang
